# JH Simple Cucumber

Version: __CUCUMBER_VERSION__

This C++20 test library binds typed step definitions to Gherkin scenarios. Its public
headers are in `simple-cucumber/include/jh/test/cucumber/`, with the Gherkin adapter
in `simple-cucumber/gherkin/include/jh/test/cucumber/`.

- [Usage and installation guide](https://github.com/JeongHan-Bae/JH-Toolkit/blob/main/simple-cucumber/README.md)
- Browse the `jh::test::cucumber` namespace and public headers in the API navigation.
